title: Hunts FH-008: Enforce tenant authorization

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 0, Engine. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Guard server admin-client operations, DB grants and RLS, revocation checks and private view exposure. Done when: Two-Space test matrix proves player, staff, partner, owner and anonymous scopes and immediate staff revocation. Requires: FH-004, FH-005, FH-006. Owner role: Security.
